title: citrus × aurantium f. natsudaidai
intro: Citrus × aurantium f. natsudaidai, commonly known as natsudaidai or yellow mandarin, is a hybrid citrus plant that belongs to the Rutaceae family. The health benefits of natsudaidai include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can help to prevent infections and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of natsudaidai include its ability to stimulate the nervous system, improve digestion, and exhibit anti-anxiety effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of natsudaidai include limonene, linalool, and geraniol, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
